SHIM CONTRACT (ADR-011 + PRD-SKILLS):
- Skill.instructions / .resources @property lazy accessors added
- Skill.layer @property (advances 1→2→3 on load)
- SkillNotFound(KeyError) defined in pythonclaw_shim/__init__.py

- discover(path: Path | None = None) — optional rebind + cache invalidate
- SkillRegistry.__len__ added
- Missing L2/L3 JSON now raises FileNotFoundError (was silent placeholder)
- @dataclass cleanup: drop dead field() declarations

GRAPHIFY AST WALKER:
- ast.walk for methods + nested functions (was top-level only)

- Phantom call edges filtered or marked kind='external'
- ast_visitor.py dedupes inlined walker in local_impl.py
- McCabe ≥1 floor for function/method/class; layer sentinel for code nodes
- Walker helpers split into src/graphify/_walkers.py to keep local_impl.py ≤150 LOC

- Layer-colour map uses int keys (1/2/3) not 'L1'/'L2'/'L3'
- Legend added (matplotlib proxy artists)
